_about: Third-party skills Fastidious uses for promotional film. Each is pinned to an exact commit and copied, unchanged except where 'rename' says, into the skills directory. Nothing here updates itself: to move a pin, follow 'Moving a pin' in PROMO-STACK.md.
policy: Pin to a commit at least a week old, or to the final release of a mature line. Only permissive licences (MIT, Apache-2.0) are installed; copyleft and non-commercial packages are referenced, never bundled.

packages.role: Renderer: HTML compositions rendered to MP4, frame by frame and identical on every render
packages.note: Final release of the 0.8 line (2 November 2026). 0.9.0 shipped the same day and was patched ten times in two days; move to 0.9 once a release has stood for two weeks.

packages.role: Motion judgement: craft laws measured from professional films, a precedent library, and gates computed on the render (look.py, lint.mjs)
packages.licence: Apache-2.0 (GSAP under the GreenSock Standard License; Three.js and opentype.js MIT; Inter OFL)

packages.role: Independent review: the Gauntlet loop, critic prompts, quality bar, frozen-time and loudness scripts, music back-timing
Sound: music, sound effects, voiceover and transcription through ElevenLabs' own skills
Lets Claude watch a reference film or its own cut: frames and a transcript, locally by default
packages.note: Optional. Installed as a skill folder only, without the plugin's SessionStart hook. Its Gemini engine uploads video to Google; use the local engine for anything confidential.
